subject: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Mills <tara@vertexpartners.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief

Team — kicking off a short planning thread to align on staffing tilts and the spend contingency scenarios we need for the QBR/annual plan packet. Goal is to lock scenario assumptions by EOD next Tuesday so Finance/People can model the top three outcomes.

High level ask (action items, owners in parens):
- Fill the attached staffing model with headcount delta assumptions for Q3 & Q4: base / constrained / upside (Owners: Jonas + Kim; file attached).
- Confirm hiring freeze trigger and date assumption (Owner: Vivek).
- Surface any one-off spend requests (marketing, infra, sales credits) that should be treated as non-recurring (All).
- Identify two hires we think are "must-commit" in upside vs. ones that can be deferred (Jonas / Mina).

Attached: 2027_staffing_model.xlsx, Q2-contingency-checklist.pdf. Please use the linked planning folder (Drive link below) and add a one-line rationale in column G of the spreadsheet for any headcount change.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (May 9): owners accept and start filling the model.
- Wed (May 11): sync call (30m) to review divergence across scenarios.
- Tue (May 16) EOD: models submitted to Finance for cost rollup.

Notes / constraints from leadership: prefer options that preserve 75% of product roadmap velocity under base; constrained should retain core SLOs + security backlog.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Director, Business Strategy | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief

Thanks Mina — I can take the hiring-freeze assumption. Quick proposal: freeze triggers at 10% QoQ ARR miss vs plan OR runway drops below 9 months. If triggered, we pull all open reqs except critical infra and security until a monthly review.

I added a tab to the Drive model with the freeze rule text and a simple calc (link below). Will review Jonas/Kim inputs Tues AM.

Vivek

Subject: Re: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief

Mina / Vivek — I started populating the staffing model. A few items I want to surface:

- Product org: base scenario holds current hiring plan (3 PMs, 2 eng leads). Constrained holds 1 PM, defers 2 eng leads. Upside accelerates to add 2 ICs for infra work.
- Sales: base keeps AE headcount, constrained suggests shifting 1 AE to SDR/expansion coverage (saves ~$160k).
- Two "must-hire" recommendations for upside: Senior Infra Engineer (security kv-cache work) and Manager, Serving Runtime. Both are critical to preserve latency targets with scaled load.

Question: Vivek — can the freeze rule be made retroactive to reqs where offer has been extended but not accepted? We need clarity on whether pending offers get honored. Also — should we treat recruiting spend (sourcing agencies) as discretionary in constrained scenario?

Jonas

From: Tara Mills <tara@vertexpartners.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief

Thanks for including Vertex. A couple procurement realities to call out from our side that will affect the constrained scenario:

- Contract dev cycles with our preferred agencies take ~6 weeks to unwind; if you plan to pause agency spend, give us a 10 business-day notice to avoid termination fees.
- For large software renewals (e.g., monitoring, APM), vendors often require quarterly notice windows — cancelling mid-quarter may not reduce cost immediately.

Practical suggestion: mark agency and contractor spend as "tier-2" discretionary in the spreadsheet so Finance can apply a staged unwind (30/60/90 days) instead of an immediate stop. Happy to map agency contracts to the spreadsheet if you share the vendor list.

Best — Tara
Vertex Partners

Subject: Re: Staffing tilt and spend contingency brief — alignment + next steps

Thanks everyone — quick summary and decisions after reading the inputs: 

Decisions / clarifications:
- Hiring-freeze rule: adopt Vivek's rule (10% QoQ ARR miss OR runway < 9 months). Freeze applies to offers not yet accepted; for offers extended but unsigned, defer start date pending monthly leadership review. (Owner: Vivek)
- Agency/contractor spend: treat as tier-2 discretionary with staged unwind (Tara to map vendor list; Owner: Kimberly).
- Must-hire list: Jonas' two items accepted for the upside scenario. These go into a prioritized short-list for Talent.

Next steps & deadlines:
- Jonas & Kim finish the model with rationale in column G by EOD Tue, May 16.
- Vivek to formalize the freeze calc in the Drive model and add a small FAQ for offers (due Wed, May 18).
- Tara to share vendor unwind mapping by Fri, May 20.
- Mina will consolidate into the QBR appendix and circulate to Finance on Mon, May 23.

Thanks — this is compact but actionable. If you see issues with the dates, flag them now; otherwise I'll lock the timeline on Monday.

Mina
